description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Tatterkite persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}.
Tatterkite dies, triggering its persist ability and Dross Scorpion.
Resolve the Tatterkite trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.
